content: वंश्य {%a.%} [वंशे भवः यत्] .²1 Relating to the main beam. .²2 Connected with the spine. .²3 Belonging to a family. .²4 Of a good family, born in a good family. .²5 Lineal, genealogical. .{@-श्यः@} .²1 A descendant, posterity (<ab>pl.</ab>); इतरेऽपि रघोर्वंश्याः <ls>R. 15. 35</ls>. .²2 A forefather, an ancestor; नूनं मत्तः परं वंश्याः पिण्डविच्छेददर्शिनः <ls>R. 1. 66</ls>. .²3 Any member of a family. .²4 A cross-beam, joist; यदस्थिभिर्निर्मितवंशवंश्यस्थूणं त्वचा रोमनखैः पिनद्धम् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 8. 33</ls>. .²5 A bone in the arm or leg. .²6 A pupil. .²7 A kinsman from seven generations above and seven below.
